mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis ( repositoryId, memberId, projectKey, projectName, coverage, bugs, complexity, codeSmells, duplicatedLinesDensity, vulnerabilities, analyzeDate ) VALUES ( #{repositoryId}, #{memberId}, #{projectKey}, #{projectName}, #{coverage}, #{bugs}, #{complexity}, #{codeSmells}, #{duplicatedLinesDensity}, #{vulnerabilities}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT AVG(coverage) AS coverage, AVG(bugs) AS bugs, AVG(complexity) AS complexity, AVG(codeSmells) AS codeSmells, AVG(duplicatedLinesDensity) AS duplicatedLinesDensity, AVG(vulnerabilities) AS vulnerabilities, AVG(totalScore) AS totalScore FROM analysis WHERE repositoryId = #{repositoryId}
